title: BEST MOB FARM in Minecraft Bedrock, MCPE, Consoles 1.21!
description:
In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to build the best Mob Farm for Minecraft Bedrock 1.21. This design is simple, beginner-friendly, and extremely efficient for farming mob drops and XP. Whether you’re playing on MCPE, Xbox, PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, or Windows 10, this farm will give you everything from gunpowder to bones, string, and more.

If you’re looking for a beginner mob farm, a hostile mob farm, or just the most efficient AFK mob farm in Minecraft Bedrock, this video has everything you need. By the end, you’ll have the best mob XP farm to level up fast and collect tons of resources.

I hope you enjoy the video and find this mob farm helpful in your survival world!
